title: Neon
look: Glass tubes of light on a dark wall: no fill, a bright core and a glow, a flicker.

doc.essence: A neon sign of the character: bent glass tubes along every edge, a soft glow, the odd flicker.
doc.notIt: Not synthwave (no fill, no sun), not blueprint (glowing colour on black).
doc.shapes: A wide translucent glow under a thin bright tube.
doc.colour: The body colour as the glow, a pale core.
doc.motion: Smooth, with a two-frame flicker now and then.
pitfalls: Thick stroke limbs read as solid bars of light.
